favourite_title: My favourite part. It has a picture.
favourite_statement: My favourite part was when {seed.generic} showed up and nobody was ready.
My favourite part was the end, because then I could go outside.
My favourite part was the picture on page 12. I looked at it for a long time.
My favourite part was when everybody learned about {seed.generic}. Me too.
My favourite part was the bit with {seed.generic}. And the bit without.
My favourite part was chapter 4. I read it three times. I didn't read chapter 5.
The best part was the twist: it was the {seed.bare} all along.
My favourite part was when it ended. That's not bad. It was a long book.
My favourite part was page 87, where nothing happens. It was very relaxing.
My favourite part was the dedication. It says 'For Mum'. Same.
My favourite part was the map at the front. I didn't read the rest, but the map was great.
My favourite part was when {seed.generic} said sorry. I didn't know that could happen.
